page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 instance in the ecs.hfr7 family powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external block storage for persistent data requirements. GPU hardware accelerators are not present on this instance type. Network connectivity is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating data transfers across connected infrastructure services.

With 768.0 GB of RAM allocated across 96 dedicated vCPUs, the server provides memory density for memory-bound applications. The reliance on remote storage introduces network dependency for I/O operations, which is supported by the 32 Gbps baseline network interface. This hardware profile suits in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, real-time data analytics, and memory-intensive enterprise workloads.
